threads.label: The treasure map
threads.text: It led you to Brandonsford at sunset, and it marks several places nearby that you don't recognize. The treasure itself is still waiting to be found.

threads.label: The dragon
threads.text: Eric the Reeve offers a thousand gold for its body, and Farmer Gill's three sons are hunting it. George the woodsman, who lost an arm to it, may visit the Clumsy Fox tonight.

threads.label: Lady Hilda
threads.text: Sir Phidipaldi told her you'd hire her after speaking with the Reeve. If you pay her, she'll join you against the dragon.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned
threads.text: Dr. Uriah met this murderous thief, who keeps a killer wasp in a jar. For a hundred gold a week, he'll do anything that lets him kill people.

threads.label: The missing shipments
threads.text: Bentley the tavern keeper and Farmer Gill say no supplies have reached Brandonsford in months. Nobody yet knows why.

threads.label: Sir Phidipaldi's duel
threads.text: He slapped Eric the Reeve and challenged him to a duel at dawn. Bentley has also banned him from the Clumsy Fox for the night.

threads.label: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
threads.text: Warwick the smith has it on display, but Farmer Gill says he always refuses to sell it.

threads.label: Quinn's revenge
threads.text: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn of the Golden Egg get back at Bentley for a hundred gold. Water-filled bottles, showily delivered, would fake an ale shipment. Something empties his stock every night.

closing: Sir Phidipaldi is at the empty Golden Egg Tavern with Quinn. Across the street, Wayman Tisdale and Dr. Uriah are in the Clumsy Fox. Dunk is out at Farmer Gill's farm on the edge of town, staying the night in the barn.
